name: Solo
summary: One role and one turn: the built-in consultant reads the project at its root under a read-only sandbox and reports back, or takes one change in a task worktree of its own when the call asks for one. No plan, no review round, no second engine — the zero-ceremony delegation, the mode a project with no config runs as, and the proof that the worktree provider is a seam rather than an assumption.
